summary: NetEase filed a Form 6-K disclosing an amendment and restatement of its 2019 Share Incentive Plan, effective June 30, 2026, in connection with its conversion to dual primary listing status on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong. The filing attaches the Second Amended and Restated 2019 Plan and is incorporated into an existing Form S-8 registration statement. There are no terms such as price per share, premium, or expected close. This is a routine compensatory plan update, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other corporate event is involved.
